subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Trial milestone triage & acceptance playbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@cloudwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Trial milestone triage & acceptance playbook

Alex / Maya —

Following our MAP, quick weekly checkpoint with the trial milestone owners. Goal is to make this message a single-source status + clear owners so we don't lose runway. See attached updated MAP (v1.3) and the trial-eval-checklist. Quick summary below.

Milestone status (green/amber/red):
- Environment & infra (green) — prod-like VPC provisioned, one GPU node reserved for canary testing.
- Data onboarding (amber) — dataset S3 access pending; Cloudwise to share cross-account role or sample export.
- Eval harness & metrics (amber) — harness skeleton in place, need final pass on pass/fail thresholds.
- Canary throughput run (red) — blocked until data access + SAML test account available.

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
1) End-to-end generation tests pass on 3 canonical prompts with >= 95% relevance.
2) Latency 95th pct under 450ms in canary environment.
3) No PII leaks in automated sanitizer tests.

Blockers / risks:
- SAML SSO metadata not yet received (blocks access to staging workspace).
- Cloudwise legal asked for an updated data retention note; Marissa pulling a one-pager.
- Eval thresholds need sign-off from Cloudwise product (Alex).

Action items (owner — due):
- Share S3 cross-account role or sample extract (Cloudwise: Alex / Maya) — due 2026-11-29
- Send SAML metadata + test credentials (Cloudwise: IT) — due 2026-11-30
- Marissa to draft data-retention note and send to legal/procurement (Marissa) — due 2026-11-28
- Karthik to pre-run the eval harness on synthetic data and lock in metric names (Karthik) — due 2026-11-30
- Priyom to schedule canary window & invite stakeholders (Priyom) — due 2026-12-01

Next sync: propose Tue 2026-12-01 10:00 PT for a 30-min runbook + canary slot decision. If that works, I'll send calendar invite.

Attachments: Cloudwise_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners), trial-eval-checklist.pdf

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Alex Rivera <alex@cloudwise.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Trial milestone triage & acceptance playbook

Thanks, Priyom —

Appreciate the consolidated view. Quick updates from our side:
- We'll extract the sample export by EOD Monday and either upload to your staging bucket or provide a cross-account role. I'll confirm which by Monday morning.
- On SAML: our IT team needs Redwood's SP metadata. Can you send the XML or the endpoint? If easier, we can do a temporary username/password for the staging canary (we understand ephemeral creds won't reflect SSO behavior but would unblock tests).
- On acceptance criteria: Product is aligned with the relevance numbers; on latency we may need a slightly looser SLO for the initial canary (500ms 95th). Can we mark latency as stretch at first run and then tighten post-canary?

Proposed: run canary with synthetic data first (Karthik) and then swap to Cloudwise sample when SAML/S3 are available. That gives us coverage without blocking the calendar.

We'll aim to have S3 access and SAML metadata for your Nov 29–30 target window.

— Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Product | Cloudwise
alex@cloudwise.com | +1 212-555-0102

Date: 2026-11-26T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Trial milestone triage & acceptance playbook

Looping in procurement/legal context and a small clarification on retention.

Alex — I'll draft the two-paragraph data-retention summary you need for internal review and attach a short addendum describing how Redwood handles ephemeral logs and token retention for trial workloads. Expect that by EOD Monday (2026-11-29). I'll also drop a procurement note that describes the temporary trial terms so your buyer has language for approvals.

On the SAML question: if Cloudwise can provide a temporary user/pass for staging, our engineering team will accept it for the initial canary as Alex suggested. We will treat that as an exception and document it in the MAP. However, for production the SAML flow must be validated.

Karthik — can you confirm synthetic harness run scope: full metric suite vs. relevance-only smoke? If you can run the relevance + PII-sanitizer checks in a standalone window this week that will give Alex confidence.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — quick update after internal huddle. Consolidating next steps and updated owners/dates below so we're all aligned.

Updated action items (final):
- Cloudwise to provide either (A) cross-account role ARN or (B) s3 sample upload (Alex / Maya) — due 2026-11-29 (status: Alex confirming option A)
- Cloudwise IT to send SAML SP/IDP metadata or accept temp creds (Alex to coordinate with IT) — due 2026-11-30 (status: pending)
- Marissa to deliver data-retention one-pager & procurement note — due 2026-11-29 (status: in draft)
- Karthik to run synthetic eval harness (relevance + sanitizer checks) and post results to the MAP folder — due 2026-11-30 (status: queued)
- Priyom to book 2026-12-01 10:00 PT runbook + canary decision meeting (calendar invite sent) — due 2026-12-01 (status: scheduled)

Contingency: If SAML/S3 are not ready by 11/30, we will proceed with a synthetic-data canary and reconvene on 12/03 for the sample-run.

Please reply if any dates look infeasible. Otherwise, I'll treat this as the single source of truth and update the MAP spreadsheet in the Drive link above.

Thanks —
